items.w3_rec1: Symptom: The fuse was blown when the unit was powered up. Action: Replaced the fuse and checked the power net for a short before retesting. Result: The unit powered up normally with no further abnormality.
items.w3_rec2: Symptom: The ADC output drifted during the offset check. Action: Recalibrated the ADC and repeated the offset check. Result: The offset check passed within the allowed tolerance.
